title: Video Edit: add LTX 2.3 as a second model option (bench LTX IC-LoRAs for clothes / character swaps)
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-1063 - Video Edit Flow (umbrella) (Fabio 2026-10-10). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-1063/plan.md. Taken over by MPI-1036's session (Video edit 17) from MPI-1060's, 2026-10-10.

Fabio 2026-10-10: ADD LTX 2.3 to the Video Edit Flow as a separate option next to H3 (H3 stays; LTX's quality is higher). Peer session for what Video Edit already does: 'video edit 17' (MPI-1036). Ingredients alone cannot edit a video (MPI-1060: a video fed as its guide is COPIED). Bench the LTX 2.3 editing IC-LoRAs on G:\ComfyUi with our int8 stack (weights in C:\AI): (1) In-Outpainting IC-LoRA - SAM3 mask of the clothes / person per frame, regenerate the masked region from the prompt (official LTX-2.3_ICLoRA_Inpaint_Two_Stage_Distilled.json); (2) Union Control (pose/depth/canny from the source video, file already at C:\AI\loras\LTX2.3\ltx-2.3-22b-ic-lora-union-control-ref0.5.safetensors) re-rendering the shot with a new look; (3) Union Control + Ingredients sheet stacked (motion from the video, identity from the sheet) = character swap. Compare against the H3 Video Edit outputs on the same clips; if LTX wins, it ships as a model choice inside the existing Video Edit Flow (same Flow, H3 kept). Coordinate with MPI-1036 (owns the Video Edit Flow). GPU work under gpu_lease.py.
